topic.summary: Jio Platforms has raised ₹8,110 crore from marquee institutional investors in its anchor book at ₹1,119 per share, setting the stage for India's largest-ever ₹30,213 crore public offering. For salaried Indian households, this mega issue directly influences equity wealth because domestic mutual funds secured over 34% of the anchor shares, channeling monthly SIP inflows into the company. Additionally, retail individual investors require a minimum outlay of 12 shares (₹13,428 at the upper price band) to participate directly, while eligible employees receive a ₹54 discount per share.
